paite: Buaina aven nung in, Paul in nungzuite asamsak a, ahanthawn a, kampha in akha a, Masidonia gam a pai ding in apawtta hi.
heading: Masidonia Leh Grik Gam Zinna
english: After the uproar had ceased, Paul sent for the disciples, took leave of them, and departed to go into Macedonia.

paite: Thu tampi anungzuite hanthawn in huai gam atawnsuak a, Grikte gam atungta hi.
english: When he had gone through those parts and had encouraged them with many words, he came into Greece.

paite: Huan huai ah kha thum ataam hi. Siria gam a long a azin dek kuan in, Judate'n amah thah asawm ziak un, Masidonia gam tawn a kilehkik atum zawta hi.
english: When he had spent three months there, and a plot was made against him by Jews as he was about to set sail for Syria, he determined to return through Macedonia.

paite: Asia gam tan a amah zuite, Beriah khomi Pirhas tapa Sopater, Thessalonika a pan Aristarkhas leh Sekundas, Darbe khomi, Gaias, Timothi leh Asia gam a Taikikas leh Trophimaste ahi uh.
english: These accompanied him as far as Asia: Sopater of Beroea, Aristarchus and Secundus of the Thessalonians, Gaius of Derbe, Timothy, and Tychicus and Trophimus of Asia.

paite: Huaite'n ka ma uh akai ua, Troas ah hon na ngak uhi.
english: But these had gone ahead, and were waiting for us at Troas.

paite: Kou bel Tanghou Silngou Soh Louh ni abei in Philippi a kipan long in ka pawt ua, ni nga nung in Troas ah akiang uh ka tung uhi; huai ah ni sagih ka taam uhi.
english: We sailed away from Philippi after the days of Unleavened Bread, and came to them at Troas in five days, where we stayed seven days.

paite: Huan nipikal a ani masapen in, tanghou balkham ding a ka kikhop lai un, Paul in akiang uah thu agen hi; ama'n azingchiang a pai atup ziak in zankim tan hial thu agen hi.
heading: Tangval Eutikas Hihdamna
english: On the first day of the week, when the disciples were gathered together to break bread, Paul talked with them, intending to depart on the next day; and continued his speech until midnight.

paite: Huan indan tungnung, ka omkhawmna uah khawnvak tampi a-om hi.
english: There were many lights in the upper room where we were gathered together.

paite: Huan amin Eutikas tangval khat tohlet ah atu a, nakpitak in ana ihmu hi. Huan Paul in thu agen sawt tak ziak in ama'n a-ihmut suak a thuakzou nawnta kei a, insawng thumna a kipan in aketa a, asisa in aphong uhi.
english: A certain young man named Eutychus sat in the window, weighed down with deep sleep. As Paul spoke still longer, being weighed down by his sleep, he fell down from the third floor and was taken up dead.

paite: Himahleh Paul akumsuk a, bohkhum in a-angpom a, "Lunglau kei un, alaitat kei lai hi," achi hi.
english: Paul went down and fell upon him, and embracing him said, “Don’t be troubled, for his life is in him.”

paite: Huan Paul akahtou nawn a, tanghou balkham in an ane a, khovak pha in akiang uah thu agen a, huai nung in apaita hi.
english: When he had gone up, had broken bread and eaten, and had talked with them a long while, even until break of day, he departed.

paite: Huan valnoupa dam in api ua, akhamuang petmah uhi.
english: They brought the boy in alive, and were greatly comforted.

paite: Huan koute Assos khua zuan in long in ka na pai masa ua, long ah Paul tuansak ka tum uhi; ama'n khe a paina lam tot atup ziak in huchibang tuh amah geldan ahi.
heading: Miletas A Zinna
english: But we, going ahead to the ship, set sail for Assos, intending to take Paul aboard there; for he had so arranged, intending himself to go by land.

paite: Huan Assos a ahon tuah chiang in, long ah ka tuangsakta ua, Mitilini khua ka tung uhi.
english: When he met us at Assos, we took him aboard and came to Mitylene.

paite: Huan huai a kipan in long in ka pai nawn ua, azing in Khios tuikulh gal ka tung ua; huan azing nawn in Samo tuikulh ka tung ua, Troguliam ah ka giak uhi. Azing nawn in Miletas khua ka tung nawn uhi.
english: Sailing from there, we came the following day opposite Chios. The next day we touched at Samos and stayed at Trogyllium, and the day after we came to Miletus.

paite: Huan Paul in Asia gam a om sawt lou a, long a Ephesa khua khen atupsa him ahi a, ahihtheihleh Jerusalem a Pentikost ni huam tum in akinpai hi.
english: For Paul had determined to sail past Ephesus, that he might not have to spend time in Asia; for he was hastening, if it were possible for him, to be in Jerusalem on the day of Pentecost.

paite: Huan Miletas a kipan in Ephesa ah mi asawl a, akiang ah saptuam upate asamsak hi.
heading: Ephesa Saptuam Upate Kiang A Paul Thu Nanung
english: From Miletus he sent to Ephesus and called to himself the elders of the assembly.

paite: Huan akiang ahong tun un, ama'n akiang uah, Asia gam ka tot chil ni a kipan na kiang ua ka om sung teng in ka omdan na thei uhi.
english: When they had come to him, he said to them, “You yourselves know, from the first day that I set foot in Asia, how I was with you all the time,

paite: Thunuailutpen kawm leh Judate'n hon thah asawm ziak ua khitui kai leh thil haksa ka tung a tungte thuak kawm in Toupa nna ka sem hi.
english: serving the Lord with all humility, with many tears, and with trials which happened to me by the plots of the Jews;

paite: Huchibang in aphatuam ding thu na kiang uah bangmah iim ka nei kei a, vantang lak leh inn teng ah thu ka hon hilh zel a,
english: how I didn’t shrink from declaring to you anything that was profitable, teaching you publicly and from house to house,

paite: Judate leh Grikte kiang ah leng Pathian lam a kisikna thu leh i Toupa Jesu Khrist lam a ginna thu ka theisak zel hi.
english: testifying both to Jews and to Greeks repentance toward God and faith toward our Lord Jesus.

paite: Ngai un, tu in Kha in hon sawl teitei a ka theih ziak in, Jerusalem a hoh dia kisa ka hi, huai ah ka tung a thil hong tung ding bangmah ka thei kei;
english: Now, behold, I go bound by the Spirit to Jerusalem, not knowing what will happen to me there;

paite: Kha Siangthou in, henna leh haksatna in nang ahon dawn hi, chi in kho teng ah ahon hilh zel hi, tuate kia ka theih ahi.
english: except that the Holy Spirit testifies in every city, saying that bonds and afflictions wait for me.

paite: Himahleh ka kitaitehna lam ka maban tun ding leh Pathian hehpihna tanchinhoih a dia theihpihtu a pang ding a Toupa Jesu kiang a huai nasepna ka muh pen sem khin phot leng, ka hinna leng khiaklah tham in ka sep kei hi.
english: But these things don’t count; nor do I hold my life dear to myself, so that I may finish my race with joy, and the ministry which I received from the Lord Jesus, to fully testify to the Good News of the grace of God.

paite: "Huan thei un, noute tengteng, Pathian lalgam thu tangkoupih a ka vakvaknate'n ka mel na mu nawnta kei ding uh chih ka thei hi.
english: “Now, behold, I know that you all, among whom I went about preaching God’s Kingdom, will see my face no more.

paite: Huaiziak in mi tengteng sisan ah ka hul ahi chih tuni in ka hon theisak hi.
english: Therefore I testify to you today that I am clean from the blood of all men,

paite: Pathian vaihawm tengteng avek in na kiang uah iim ka nei kei hi.
english: for I didn’t shrink from declaring to you the whole counsel of God.

paite: Pathian saptuamte, ama sisan a aleite, vak ding in noumau leh na heute tengteng uh tung ah pilvang un, Kha Siangthou in atung uah nou heutu in ahon bawl hi.
english: Take heed, therefore, to yourselves and to all the flock, in which the Holy Spirit has made you overseers, to shepherd the assembly of the Lord and God which he purchased with his own blood.

paite: Ka pai nung in na lak uah ngehangte ahong lut ding ua, pawlte ahawi kei ding uh chih ka thei hi.
english: For I know that after my departure, vicious wolves will enter in among you, not sparing the flock.

paite: Noumau lak a mi nangawn, nungzui pawlte amau lam a kaimang ding in thu tuam gen na hong om ding uh.
english: Men will arise from among your own selves, speaking perverse things, to draw away the disciples after them.

paite: Huaiziak in limsak unla; kum thum hilhial khitui ke kawm a, sun leh zan a michih taihilh ka tawplouhdan, theigige un.
english: Therefore watch, remembering that for a period of three years I didn’t cease to admonish everyone night and day with tears.

paite: "Tu in noute Pathian leh ahehpihna ah ka hon kemsak hi, huai in noute ahon bawllian thei a, mi lungsim siangthoute kiang ah goutan ahon neisak thei lai hi.
english: Now, brothers, I entrust you to God and to the word of his grace, which is able to build up and to give you the inheritance among all those who are sanctified.

paite: Kuamah dangka, dangka-eng leh puansilh ka eng ngei kei.
english: I coveted no one’s silver, gold, or clothing.

paite: Hiai khutte'n keimah leh ka lawmte taksap asepkhiak zeldan, noumau ngei in na thei uhi.
english: You yourselves know that these hands served my necessities, and those who were with me.

paite: Bangkim ka hih peuhmah na chin ding ua ka hih ahi, huchibang a semgim leh Toupa Jesu thu theigige kawm in mihatloute na panpih ding uh ahi; amah mah in, 'Lak sang in piak in lukhawng anei zaw' achih," achi hi.
english: In all things I gave you an example, that so laboring you ought to help the weak, and to remember the words of the Lord Jesus, that he himself said, ‘It is more blessed to give than to receive.’ ”

paite: Huai thu agen khit in akhukdin a, avek un athum uhi.
english: When he had spoken these things, he knelt down and prayed with them all.

paite: Huan avek un akap huphup ua, Paul ngawng ah kawi in atawp uhi.
english: They all wept freely, and fell on Paul’s neck and kissed him,

paite: Amel amuh nawn tak louh ding thu agen alungkhamna pen uh ahi. Huan long pha in amah ava kha uhi.
english: sorrowing most of all because of the word which he had spoken, that they should see his face no more. Then they accompanied him to the ship.
